name: Adela J. Kaempfer (Adams)
notable_stories: Moved to Colorado with her parents in 1870
Described as quiet, retiring, and deeply religious
Her obituary describes her as quiet and retiring but with many friends, a kind and loving mother devoted to her children.
milestones: Married James Casper Adams (m. 26 Feb 1888, Douglas County, CO)
Raised four surviving children after her divorce: Minnie, Ethel, Reda, and Frank
Religion: Never affiliated with a church in Castle Rock but described as deeply religious
Buried at Cedar Hill(s) Cemetery in Castle Rock, CO
locations: Cedar Hill Cemetery, Castle Rock, CO
sources: Descendants of Jose Pierre Adams, compiled by William W. "Bill" Allen (2 April 2011 edition)
notes: Five children were born to the marriage, four surviving her in 1941: Minnie F. Seeley (Sturgis, SD), Ethel E. Mead (Castle Rock, CO), Reda F. Olsen and Frank M. Adams (Denver, CO) [Bill Allen, Descendants of Jose Pierre Adams, 2011, line 4435]

Sisters Emma E. Ingersoll of Denver and Minnie C. Sturdevant of Castle Rock, and brother A. C. G. Kaempfer of Bridgeport, Nebraska survived her; also seven grandchildren and four great-grandchildren [Bill Allen, Descendants of Jose Pierre Adams, 2011, line 4437]

Funeral at the Andrew Funeral Home, Rev. William J. Wilcox officiating (obituary from the Record Journal of Douglas County, October 1941) [Bill Allen, Descendants of Jose Pierre Adams, 2011, line 4449]
